english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\cos x\cos\left(x+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)+\cos\left(x+\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\right)\cos(x+\pi)+\cos\left(x+\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)\cos\left(x+\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$. Then the value of $f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{7}\right)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\cos x\cos\left(x+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)+\cos\left(x+\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\right)\cos(x+\pi)+\cos\left(x+\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)\cos\left(x+\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब $f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{7}\right)$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Product to sum on each term, $\phi_m=x+\dfrac{2m\pi}{3}$ ($m=0,1,2$): $\cos\phi_m\cos\left(\phi_m+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=\dfrac12\left[\cos\left(2\phi_m+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)+\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right]$
The last sum has angles in AP with difference $\dfrac{4\pi}{3}$ and $3\cdot\dfrac{4\pi}{3}=4\pi$: it is $0$ (formula numerator $\sin2\pi=0$)
solution_full: Write the three products as $\cos\phi_m\cos\left(\phi_m+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ with $\phi_m=x+\dfrac{2m\pi}{3}$, $m=0,1,2$ (indeed $\phi_1+\dfrac{\pi}{3}=x+\pi$ and $\phi_2+\dfrac{\pi}{3}=x+\dfrac{5\pi}{3}$).
Product to sum: $2\cos P\cos Q=\cos(P+Q)+\cos(P-Q)$ gives $\cos\phi_m\cos\left(\phi_m+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=\dfrac12\cos\left(2\phi_m+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)+\dfrac14$.

Angles in AP with first term $a=2x+\dfrac{\pi}{3}$, difference $d=\dfrac{4\pi}{3}$, $n=3$ terms: the sum is $\dfrac{\sin\frac{nd}{2}}{\sin\frac{d}{2}}\cos\left(a+\dfrac{(n-1)d}{2}\right)$ with $\sin\dfrac{nd}{2}=\sin2\pi=0$ and $\sin\dfrac{d}{2}=\sin\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\ne0$, so it is $0$.
(At $x=\dfrac{\pi}{7}$ no factor has a standard value, so direct evaluation is not practical.)
originality_note: New: three products of cosines sixty degrees apart, placed at the vertices of an equilateral rotation, add to a constant because the product-to-sum remainders form a vanishing AP sum (way 4, hidden invariant); asking at x = pi/7 forces the invariant. Closest known: cos x + cos(x + 2pi/3) + cos(x + 4pi/3) = 0 and cos^2 x + cos^2(x + 2pi/3) + cos^2(x + 4pi/3) = 3/2. Different because: the terms are products of DIFFERENT angles and the constant comes from cos(pi/3).
blueprint_concepts: Summation of trigonometric series with angles in AP

concept_use.Summation of trigonometric series with a: The remainders cos(2x + pi/3 + 4m pi/3), m = 0, 1, 2, are in AP and sum to 0 by the AP formula.
concept_use.Sum-to-product and product-to-sum transf: Each product cos phi cos(phi + pi/3) = (1/2)cos(2phi + pi/3) + 1/4.
